contract.semantics: bin/subagent (the launch chokepoint) applies a resident-aware memory-budget gate to LOCAL-model lanes only (provider=ollama, non-`:cloud` tag).  Cloud-API lanes (deepseek / claude / pi-openrouter / `:cloud` ollama tags) keep a small local RSS and dispatch freely — the gate never applies.  Gate ACTIVE only when a resident model server is present (declared WEIZIGO_HOST_TENANT_RESERVATION_MB > 0, or auto-detected `ollama runner --mlx-engine` RSS > 0): no tenant ⇒ no reduced budget ⇒ inactive.  Active gate admits iff available_memory >= lane_cost + margin (lane_cost default 16384 MB = one 27b MLX model, WEIZIGO_LANE_COST_MB overrides; margin 2048 MB).  available_memory is the system-wide reading (WEIZIGO_HOST_MEM_AVAIL_MB injects it, the same hook tools/runner uses — the floor is never tested by exhausting the host).  Reading unavailable (WEIZIGO_HOST_MEM_UNAVAIL=1) ⇒ gate INERT — cannot measure = cannot refuse, the runner guard's stance.  Refusal is LIST-WAIT: the row stays dispatchable and nothing is killed.  --override-memory-gate=<reason> (reason REQUIRED; bare flag refuses) launches anyway with a loud warning — the --allow-unisolated spirit, per-launch human decision, nothing recorded.

implementation.functions: _host_total_mb(), _host_avail_mb(), _resident_tenant_mb(), _lane_is_memory_heavy(), _memory_gate_verdict() in bin/subagent, inserted after the provider configuration maps and before main(); the gate call site sits in main() after model resolution and before the T628 provider-window gate, so a refusal precedes nonce/task work and a dry-run reveals the same refusal a launch would.
implementation.tenant_resolution: mirror of tools/runner._declared_tenant_reservation_bytes (T711), in MB: 1. WEIZIGO_HOST_TENANT_RESERVATION_MB verbatim (0 = explicitly no tenant); 2. when the available reading is INJECTED (WEIZIGO_HOST_MEM_AVAIL_MB set), no auto-detection — the test owns the whole scenario, a tenant must be declared; 3. otherwise auto-detect every process whose command carries `ollama runner --mlx-engine` and sum its RSS (kB from `ps -axo pid=,rss=,command=`, same substring match T711 confirmed).
implementation.decision_rule: admit iff avail >= cost + margin.  The T711 'available-to-the-fleet = available + tenant' arithmetic is deliberately NOT applied here: that was for the guard's panic-floor comparison (the tenant cancels out of it); a NEW lane cannot reclaim the tenant's RSS (anonymous/wired, not reclaimable), so adding the tenant back would admit two 16 GB lanes onto a host that fits one.  In-flight lanes are charged implicitly — each resident lane lowers the next avail reading.  The reduced budget (host total − tenant) is computed and reported as a diagnostic on every memory-heavy dispatch.
implementation.diagnostic: on admit, one [subagent] T713 stderr line reports the tenant and reduced budget (e.g. 'model server resident (tenant 8000 MB) — fleet budget reduced to 41152 MB (total 49152 MB)') or the no-tenant case; on refusal, the REFUSED message names the avail reading, the tenant, the lane cost + margin, and the list-wait directive ('idle is acceptable, killing a running lane is not').
implementation.flag: --override-memory-gate=<reason> (parse_argv's `=` branch picks it up unchanged); a bare --override-memory-gate (parse_argv yields True) refuses with 'requires a reason'.
